description: Send USDt from Liquid to another network (Ethereum, Tron, BNB Smart Chain, Polygon, Solana) via SideShift. *** CUSTODIAL ***: this is the ONE flow where funds LEAVE the non-custodial sphere — you send USDt to SideShift's deposit address and THEY pay out from their reserve on the target network (escrow states, possible review/refund). MOVES MONEY: the USDt send passes through the owner's guardrails (value caps; with the allowlist on, BOTH the destination settle_address AND the refund_address must be opted in) BEFORE signing. amount_sats is USDt BASE UNITS. Irreversible once broadcast; the result carries custodial:true.

amount_sats.description: Amount in the asset's BASE UNITS (sats), as a decimal integer STRING. 1 DePix cent = 1,000,000 sats. Never pass a BRL value here.

network.description: Target network to send USDt to: ethereum, tron (TRC-20), bsc (BEP-20), polygon, or solana (SPL). A Liquid→Liquid USDt move needs no shift — use wallet_send for that.

refund_address.description: Optional Liquid address SideShift refunds the USDt to if the shift fails. Checked against allowlist.sideshiftRefundAddresses when the allowlist is enabled (§4.3).

settle_address.description: FINAL destination address on `network` (0x… for EVM, T… for Tron, base58 for Solana). Checked against the destination allowlist when it is enabled (§4.3).

name: wallet_shift_usdt

brl_cents.description: The USDt sent valued in BRL cents — what was counted against the guardrail (§4.3).

custodial.description: Always true — SideShift is CUSTODIAL: once sent, the funds are in SideShift's custody, not yours.

deposit_address.description: SideShift's Liquid deposit address the USDt was sent to — CUSTODIAL: this address is theirs.

deposit_amount_sats.description: USDt sent from the wallet (base units, as a decimal string).

network.description: The target network the USDt was shifted to.

post_sync_failed.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) AFTER this money-moving call failed. The money already moved (see the txid); the next balance read reflects it. This is never a failure of the operation itself.

refund_address.description: The refund address, or null when none was set.

settle_address.description: The FINAL destination address on the target network.

settle_amount.description: USDt that will land on the target network (decimal), when quoted.

shift_id.description: SideShift shift id — track it at sideshift.ai/orders/<id>.

stale.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) before this read/spend FAILED and the result reflects the last persisted snapshot — the on-chain state may be newer. Reads never fail on a provider outage; they serve the snapshot with this flag. Absent means the state was refreshed.

txid.description: The broadcast Liquid txid of the USDt send.

title: Shift USDt cross-network (SideShift — CUSTODIAL)
